locked.say: Tab (Edit Mode) unlocks in Lesson 05. Hold that thought.

bites.title: The control room
bites.body: The Properties editor is a filing cabinet. Each icon down its left edge opens a drawer: render, output, scene, world, object, modifiers, materials and more. Hover any icon and press F1.

bites.title: The object drawer
bites.body: Click the orange square tab (Object). Under Transform, set Scale Z to 2. Same numbers as the N sidebar, bigger cabinet.
bites.hint: Properties editor, orange square icon, Transform, Scale, the Z field. Double-click and type 2.
bites.praise: A tall cube. A box with ambition.

bites.title: Undo one field
bites.body: Right-click the Scale Z field and choose Reset to Default Value. Right-click menus on fields are full of gems like this.
bites.hint: Right-click directly on the Z number, then Reset to Default Value.

bites.title: The wrench
bites.body: Click the blue wrench tab: Modifiers. Modifiers change a shape without touching its real geometry. Recipes, not edits.
bites.hint: Blue wrench icon, a little below the orange square.

bites.title: Make it smooth
bites.body: Click Add Modifier, then Generate, then Subdivision Surface. The cube puffs into a soft blob.

bites.title: Smoother
bites.body: In the Subdivision panel, set Levels Viewport to 3. More levels, smoother surface, heavier mesh.
bites.hint: Levels Viewport is the first number in the modifier panel.

bites.title: Shade smooth
bites.body: Right-click the cube in the viewport and choose Shade Smooth. The faceted look melts away.
bites.hint: Right-click over the cube itself. Shade Smooth is near the top of the menu.

bites.title: Stack another
bites.body: Add Modifier, Generate, Bevel. Modifiers stack like pancakes: the top one runs first, then the next.

bites.title: Change the order
bites.body: Drag the Bevel panel above Subdivision by its handle (the dotted grip at the top-right of the panel), or use its dropdown arrow and pick Move to First. See how the edges tighten?
bites.hint: Each modifier header has a small dropdown arrow. Move to First lives there.

bites.title: Peek without it
bites.body: Click the little monitor icon in the Subdivision header to switch it off in the viewport. Click again to switch it back on.
bites.hint: Each modifier header has toggle icons. The monitor is Show in Viewport.

bites.title: Lesson 04: cleared
bites.body:
Properties, Object transforms, field resets, modifiers, the stack, and Shade Smooth. You've seen inside the machine.

Reward: Tab is unlocked. Next lesson you climb inside the mesh itself.
